name: Cabozantinib + Nivolumab (IO + TKI, first-line clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Continuous therapy: cabozantinib 40 mg PO once daily every day, plus nivolumab 240 mg IV every 2 weeks (or 480 mg every 4 weeks). Continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity; nivolumab generally capped at about 2 years.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Note the combination cabozantinib dose is 40 mg once daily, LOWER than the 60 mg single-agent dose.
Distinguish TKI toxicity (hypertension, diarrhea, hand-foot skin reaction) from immune-related effects.
Blood pressure monitoring; assess for proteinuria; immune adverse event counseling.
monitoring: immune toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose) as indicated

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 hypertension, diarrhea, or hand-foot skin reaction
doseModificationRules.text: Hold cabozantinib and resume at a reduced dose (20 mg, then 20 mg every other day) per labeling for persistent grade 3 toxicity.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold nivolumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Cabozantinib
drugs.notes: Cabozantinib 40 mg PO once daily, continuous (shown across all cycle days). This combination dose (40 mg) is intentionally LOWER than the 60 mg single-agent cabozantinib dose. Authored from standard first-line clear-cell RCC practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; CheckMate-9ER supporting evidence).

provenance.locator: cabozantinib 40 mg + nivolumab, first-line clear-cell RCC

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.notes: Nivolumab 240 mg IV flat every 2 weeks (days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle), or 480 mg every 4 weeks as a label-equivalent alternative. Combined with cabozantinib as first-line therapy. Authored from standard practice (CheckMate-9ER).
